summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Times Tables gamified app (no backend). Covered Home hero/stats/range selector/mode cards, Quick-Fire (correct increments score & combo, wrong resets combo), Streak (correct increments, wrong ends run, Try Again restarts), Boss (brief -> Engage -> 3 hearts -> DEFEAT after losing all lives), Stats per-table rows, Shop 4 items + buy increments owned, HUD coins/level updates, navigation, and localStorage persistence across reload. All flows worked as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: Boss.jsx timer effect re-creates setInterval on every tick (dependency on `time`), which is wasteful but functionally fine. Could be refactored to ref-based or single interval.
QuickFire.jsx timer has same pattern (`time` in deps causes reinit each second). Works but inefficient.

storage.js: `consumePowerup` calls getState() then updateState — there is a benign read-then-write race (single-threaded JS, fine for now). Consider making updateState atomic via the updater fn directly.
Question.jsx: input `type="number"` plus regex stripping is double-defensive; type=number on its own can allow 'e','+','-','.' in some browsers — current onChange filter is correct.
No data-testid on Home `cta-start-quickfire` link issue — already present and works.
Powerups state is read from `state` from subscribe; works. No issues observed.
seed_data_creation: Injected coins=500 into localStorage (key tt_arena_state_v1) to verify Shop buy flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is purely client-side using localStorage key 'tt_arena_state_v1'. To test Shop, mutate localStorage.coins. All data-testids documented in review request are present and reliable. Boss DEFEAT requires 3 wrong answers (each takes ~1s to process). Streak ending takes ~600ms after wrong submit.
